title: K2U Platform Administrator Practice Exam 2
note: Questions 45-49, 51, 55 and 57-59 were answered correctly and their text wasn't captured; add them on a future pass.

cards.prompt: What is true regarding custom fields? (2)
options: Custom fields cannot be deleted once created
The field type can be changed after creation
FLS does not apply to custom fields
Custom fields can be created on standard or custom objects
answer: The field type can be changed after creation
Custom fields can be created on standard or custom objects
cards.why: Type changes may lose data. FLS applies to all fields.
cards.traps: 'Can't delete' is a standard-field rule applied to custom fields.

cards.prompt: Which fields are required to create users with Data Loader?
options: First Name, Last Name, Email, ProfileId, Role
First Name, Last Name, Username, Alias, Email, ProfileId
First Name, Last Name, ProfileId, User License
First Name, Username, Email, Role, User License
answer: First Name, Last Name, Username, Alias, Email, ProfileId
cards.why: Also locale, language, email encoding, time zone. Role is optional; the license comes from the profile.
cards.strip: Find what every right answer must include: Username.

cards.prompt: What can a Case Queue be used for?
options: Manage distribution of custom object records
cards.why: Queues hold unassigned records; members pick them up. Queues can own records.
cards.strip: The object is in the name.

cards.prompt: Five of the reps on a shared custom profile need Read access to the Warehouse field.
answer: Assign a permission set with Read FLS on the field
cards.why: Editing the profile gives everyone access; a new profile is heavy.
cards.strip: Some users on a profile → permission set.

cards.prompt: Options to modify the standard Lead Rating picklist values? (3)
cards.why: The standard FIELD can't be deleted; its VALUES can be added, deleted, reordered, deactivated.

cards.prompt: Web-to-Case: email the customer an acknowledgment with response time based on service level.
answer: Auto-response rules with multiple rule entries
cards.why: Built-in feature covers everything; entries are ordered, first match wins.
cards.traps: Flow could work but rebuilds a feature; assignment rules set owners.

cards.prompt: Keep the sales team out of the custom HR app and its tabs. (2)
answer: Remove object- and field-level access to the HR objects from the sales profile
Uncheck the HR app's 'Visible' checkbox on the sales profile
cards.why: Hiding the app is cosmetic; removing object access is security.
cards.traps: Apps have no 'Hidden' setting (tabs do); OWD isn't per profile.

cards.prompt: Notify the manager and reassign when a low-priority case isn't resolved in 48 hours.
answer: Escalation rule that reassigns and emails the manager
cards.why: Time-based = escalation. Uses business hours.
cards.traps: 'Process' = retired Process Builder; assignment rules only run at create/edit.

cards.prompt: Change a user's email when the old email may be compromised.
answer: Update the email and reset the password in the same operation
cards.why: The reset link goes to the new address and must be used to activate it.

cards.prompt: Case email required only if phone is blank.
cards.why: AND(ISBLANK(SuppliedPhone), ISBLANK(SuppliedEmail)).

cards.prompt: Private sharing model: how do same-level role peers access each other's data?
cards.why: Role hierarchy only opens upward. Share groups are for Experience Cloud users.

cards.prompt: One user on a shared profile has extra permissions. Efficiently find out how.
answer: User Access Summary (View Summary on the user record)
cards.why: Shows every permission and its source, plus groups and queues.
cards.traps: 'Permissions History' doesn't exist; reviewing every permission set isn't efficient.

cards.prompt: Daily email to a manager if open cases exceed 100, in Lightning.
answer: Ask the manager to subscribe to an open case report
cards.why: Subscriptions can have conditions (Record Count > 100).
cards.traps: Record-triggered flows can't count totals; scheduled refresh is Classic.

cards.prompt: Which features control record sharing? (3)
cards.why: Profiles and permission sets control what users DO.

cards.prompt: Relative value for a personalized report filter so users see only accounts they own?
cards.why: Owner equals $USER.

cards.prompt: What is required to use change sets between two orgs? (2)
answer: A deployment connection between the orgs
Both orgs affiliated with the same production org
cards.why: Change sets move metadata only. Developer Edition orgs can't use them.

cards.prompt: John wants colleagues to collaborate on a case for an account he owns. (2)
answer: Add users to the case team
cards.why: John is a user: record-level tools only. OWD and sharing rules are admin tools and too broad for one case.

cards.prompt: Reps can't see a new Lightning record page. Why? (2)
answer: The page wasn't assigned to any profiles
cards.why: Priority: app + record type + profile > app default > org default.
cards.traps: 'Customize Applications' is for building, not viewing.

cards.prompt: John Smith is a contact at Acme and at Girls Who Code, creating a duplicate.
answer: Enable Contacts to Multiple Accounts; Acme as the direct account, GWC via Related Contacts
cards.why: One record, two accounts, different roles.
cards.traps: Visualforce is code; record types don't merge records.

cards.prompt: What does a Lightning page layout control? (3)
cards.why: Edit permission comes from profiles and sharing; related list type is set in App Builder.

cards.prompt: What can a Salesforce object be compared to?
answer: A table of data with records and fields
cards.why: Object = table, field = column, record = row.

cards.prompt: How can record types show different information to divisions? (3)
cards.why: Record types don't control apps or which records users see.

cards.prompt: Capabilities of lookup but NOT master-detail? (2)
answer: The field doesn't need to be required
The child can have a different owner
cards.why: Cascade delete and roll-ups are master-detail.

cards.prompt: Data Import Wizard capabilities for campaigns? (2)
answer: Add existing contacts to a campaign in the same import
cards.why: One object per import; can't create accounts and add them.

cards.prompt: Web-to-Lead: different email per product, generic if none.
cards.why: One active rule, many entries; catch-all entry last. 'Could satisfy' isn't hedging.

cards.prompt: Web-to-Lead: thank the prospect AND alert the Sales Manager.
answer: Auto-response rule plus a flow that emails the manager
cards.why: Auto-response sends one email to the submitter only; no CC.

cards.prompt: Reps re-enter the same account team on every new account.
answer: Default Account Team in Personal Settings
cards.why: Per-user preference. Admin settings only enable Account Teams.

cards.prompt: Which objects can be Campaign Members? (3)
cards.why: Accounts require 'Accounts as Campaign Members'. Opportunities link via Primary Campaign Source.

cards.prompt: True about automated case actions? (2)
answer: Assignment rule changes show the Automated Case User in Case History
Web-to-Case creation shows the Automated Case User in Case History
cards.why: Default Case Owner = owner of unmatched cases.

cards.prompt: True about auto-response rules? (2)
answer: They apply to cases and leads
Different templates can be used for different criteria
cards.why: One email only, no tasks; one active rule.

cards.prompt: Support Managers must approve agents' emails. (3)
cards.why: Hold it (draft) → route it (approval) → send it (send action). No manager permission needed.

cards.prompt: Who can be added as Event Attendees in Lightning? (3)
cards.why: Also Person Accounts. An attendee is a person.

cards.prompt: What does Lightning Sync sync with Microsoft Exchange? (2)
cards.why: Sync = things kept matched in both places. Emails are captured, not synced.

cards.prompt: True about the best answer in Chatter Questions? (2)
answer: A copy appears at the top of the answers with a check mark
Only one answer can be the best answer
cards.why: The asker or a moderator selects it; it can be removed.

cards.prompt: True about adding records to Chatter groups?
options: All group users can see added records
Any standard or custom object can be added
Records can't be added to groups that allow customers
answer: Records can't be added to groups that allow customers
cards.why: Users only see records they already have access to; custom objects need 'Allow in Chatter Groups'.

cards.prompt: EAC + Outlook integration users can: (2)
answer: Change email associations from their Outlook integration
See a selected email's related records and sharing settings
cards.why: Timeline button is 'Manage Associations'; pane components include Quote and Contract.
cards.traps: 'Edit Associations' and 'Task component' are made up.

cards.prompt: Manage tasks differently for two sales types with different fields. (2)
cards.why: Sales process only controls Opportunity Stage.

cards.prompt: Schedule monthly events that repeat indefinitely in Lightning.
answer: Add the 'Repeat' checkbox to the Event page layout
cards.why: Event Series; 'Recurring Events' in Activity Settings is Classic.
cards.strip: 'After reviewing Activity Settings' hints the answer isn't there.

cards.prompt: What is required to update a record using Data Loader?
cards.why: 15- or 18-character ID.

cards.prompt: Reps need a guided CSV contact import with simple mapping. What to enable?
cards.why: A Setup toggle for reps; contacts and leads.

cards.prompt: Archive old inactive contacts to free storage. Most efficient?
answer: Export with Data Loader or a report, then delete with Data Loader
cards.why: Include IDs in the export to use as the delete file.

cards.prompt: True about External ID matching in the Import Wizard? (2)
answer: Available for any importable object with an External ID field
Existing records with matching External IDs are detected
cards.why: Not limited to solutions or custom objects.

cards.prompt: How does Salesforce support the sales process? (3)
answer: Opportunity Teams associate a group with a deal
Features include leads, campaigns, products, price books, opportunities, quotes
Different products can use different processes
cards.why: Contact roles can include other accounts' contacts. Campaign Influence attributes credit to campaigns; Team Selling splits revenue among people.

cards.prompt: A new manager gets 'Insufficient Privileges' running a quota report on the Forecast object. Why? (3)
answer: No access to the Forecast object
No access to the report folder
cards.why: Permission + folder + data.
cards.traps: 'Run Other User Reports' and 'Run All Reports' are made up.

cards.prompt: Schedule-triggered flow: send a custom email instead of the default when a record update fails. (2)
cards.why: A fault connector is Flow's try/except.

cards.prompt: Benefits of a custom picklist to end users? (2)
cards.why: Only admins add values; forcing a selection needs 'required'.

cards.prompt: Users need manager approval before converting a lead. (2)
answer: Record types and a new page layout on Lead
An approval process with the manager as approver
cards.why: Unapproved layout hides Convert; approval's field update switches the record type.
cards.traps: Validation rules don't reliably block conversion; a task enforces nothing.

cards.prompt: Flow assigns the first 50 leads to Agent A, loops through the rest, and so on. Required elements? (3)
cards.why: First 50 → Collection Sort; loops → Loop; set value → Assignment. No screens for imports and integrations.

cards.prompt: An agent action calling an Apex class works for the developer but fails for the agent, which has object permissions. Minimal fix?
answer: Give the agent user's profile access to the Apex class
cards.why: Works for one user, fails for another → missing access.
cards.traps: Data library is for knowledge; Modify All Data violates least privilege.

cards.prompt: Which Agent Builder tool tests an agent?
cards.why: Light testing: chat with the agent and see which topics and actions it chose.
